notes.title: Pre-Release Build Update + Participation
notes.notes: [p]A massive update for Broke Signal Badlands has been released, adding the following changes, fixes, and additions. We are gearing up for release on Steam soon, which means that we now need a wave of players to play the game! [url="https://forwardinstinct.itch.io/broke-signal-badlands"]Head here and scroll to the bottom to participate.[/url][/p][p]We have added a massive amount of new content and features. Let's dig in:[/p][list][*][p]The game now totals [b]65+ encounters, with 22 new encounters added.[/b] The wordcount has expanded to 40,000+ words, or the length of a small book. [b][i]This represents the final, full content of the game![/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional encounter and landmark locations have been added to the map. [/b]The map should feel a bit more alive and busy than before as a result.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A few new items[/b] have been added, to be found by the player.[/p][/*][*][p]An extremely cool [b]new secret endgame weapon[/b] has been added. Can you unlock it?[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 new shootouts[/b] have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]1 unique[b] knife fight encounter[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The dialogue can now be [b]advanced by hitting Space[/b], and options can now be [b]selected by using WASD and Space[/b]! Mice haters rejoice. You still have to drag dice to roll and use the mouse to shoot/stab, however.[/p][/*][/list][p]Some changes and bugfixes have also been addressed:[/p][list][*][p][b]Encounters are rebalanced[/b] to properly balance them for all the different encounters players can face now. You may notice some are easier than before, while some are a bit harder.[/p][/*][*][p]A black background has been added to the journal screen, to make it easier to read.[/p][/*][*][p]The stats screen has been amended to make it easier to understand, and persuade players to pick an Ace skill.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial has been updated to make Dusk/Dawn dice clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]Several warning messages and text have been updated to make it clearer that you need to drag dice to roll them.[/p][/*][*][p]Some cursory spelling and phrasing updates to existing encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double-clicking the roll button when rolling causing the encounter to fail.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dice staying in the rack when dragging a dice but choosing to back out of the encounter, resulting in extra dice available for the next encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dice-roller preview dice not changing theme properly between day and night.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed aspect ratio frame not properly changing theme between day and night.[/p][/*][/list][p]A few changes remain on the horizon for Steam, and are not in the game yet. This includes:[/p][list][*][p]New Music[/p][/*][*][p]Music Playlist setup[/p][/*][*][p]Sound pass on encounters[/p][/*][*][p]Art for each ending[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Prequel Tutorial Section[/p][/*][*][p]Controls for controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Options, such as precise glitching settings and image scanner speed[/p][/*][*][p]Options in Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]New demo build with the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p]Known Issues in this build:[/p][list][*][p]Weird errors with allocating an ace in the stats screen when you empty a stat entirely, then fill it back up and ace the stat.[/p][/*][*][p]Weird issue with dice getting "eaten" when adding to a stat with no current dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Can drag dice, pointlessly, in the stats screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet count during shootouts shows bullets rolled, but does not show them vanish as they're fired.[/p][/*][*][p]Escaping the Red Hills Marina monster is not affected by if you are out of dice on the second roll - need to be addressed.[/p][/*][/list]
